name: Extra Pyro Talent
body:
Through constant practice, you have learned another special pyro trick.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro talent class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional pyro talent. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this pyro talent.

Special: You can take Extra Pyro Talent multiple times.
